anchors.quote: Paragraph 3.11 of the Code of Conduct provides that distributors should not offer any gifts (other than a discount of fees or charges) in promoting a specific investment product or a particular type of investment product to a client.

anchors.quote: If gifts are offered in such a way that they are linked to a particular type of investment product, such as certain types of funds or funds offered by certain fund houses, then such gifts will be bound by this requirement as investors may be distracted from the unique features and risks of such particular funds3.

assumptions: The prohibition applies when gift is true, at least one of specific or producttype is true, and discount is false.
The output true means that the quoted paragraph 3.11 prohibition applies; it does not determine any consequence under section 103 or another provision.
The supplied boolean classifications are complete factual inputs, as required by the task semantics.
